title: Animal Disease FarmData4All i4Trust
description: Object modelling an animal disease for a livestock farm.

type.description: NGSI Entity Type. It has to be AnimalDisease

disease.description: Property. Animal disease as diagnosed by a veterinarian. Reference list of diseases: https://www.mapa.gob.es/es/ganaderia/temas/sanidad-animal-higiene-ganadera/sanidad-animal/enfermedades/

diagnosticTest.description: Property. Diagnostic test performed on the animals for the determination of the disease by a veterinarian

date.description: Property. Date of diagnosis of the disease by a veterinarian

veterinarianTreatment.description: Relationship. Medical treatment diagnosed by the veterinarian to treat the disease. Model:'https://github.com/smart-data-models/dataModel.Agrifood/blob/master/VeterinarianTreatment/schema.json'

animals.description: Relationship. Animal or list of animals diagnosed with the disease. Model:'https://github.com/smart-data-models/dataModel.Agrifood/blob/master/Animal/schema.json'

veterinarian.description: Relationship. Diagnostic veterinarian. Relationship to the prescribing veterinarian
